# Make sure empty answer and application forms cannot create broken entries

## What & Why
The forms currently rely on browser required fields and submit guards. A focused browser test would protect users from accidentally creating blank answer or application cards if form markup or validation changes.

## Done looks like
- Browser coverage confirms an empty answer cannot be saved and the dialog remains open.
- Browser coverage confirms an application without a company or role cannot be saved and the dialog remains open.
- Valid entries can still be saved after the validation attempt.

- artifacts/escape-hatch/src/App.tsx
